purpose: Narrow source concordance and rights-provenance evidence for CPL trauma-informed care; no individual treatment or publication approval

records.title: Practical Guide for Implementing a Trauma-Informed Approach
records.sourceDateMeaning: Agency publication year (PEP23-06-05-005); not webpage revision date
records.claimCompared: SAMHSA defines four assumptions (realize, recognize, respond, resist retraumatization), six principles (safety, transparency, peer support, collaboration, empowerment/voice/choice, cultural/historical/gender issues), ten organization-level domains. Trauma-informed stance is not identical to trauma-specific treatment.
records.limits: CPL's largely resource-level guidance does not demonstrate organization-wide implementation, staff/leadership policy adherence, client feedback, or outcomes. Source PDF text was reviewed, but web screenshot was access-restricted; no visual/PDF-structure assurance.
records.rights: SAMHSA publication specifically says public domain, attribution appreciated, no fee distribution without written authorization; this does not clear third-party CPL content.

records.title: Trauma-Informed Care clinical report
records.claimCompared: Pediatric TIC emphasizes safe, relational care; caregiver-child relationship, development, resilience, cultural context, symptom assessment, referral and prevention of re-traumatization and secondary traumatic stress.
records.limits: Report publisher full-text may require access; available published abstract/metadata reviewed; pediatric policies are not standalone trauma or child welfare treatment protocols.
records.rights: AAP publication rights not established for reproducing report or figures; link only

records.title: How to Provide Trauma-Informed Care: Detection & Identification
